title: Baseball Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Baseball Scoreboard plugin - displays live, recent, and upcoming MLB, MiLB, and NCAA Baseball games

scroll_card.title: Matchup Card Layout
scroll_card.description: Layout of an upcoming or in-progress matchup: the separator drawn between the two teams, and how the date and time are written. These apply to the scroll and Vegas cards and to the full-screen scoreboard alike -- the full-screen one is controlled by its own "Middle of a Full-Screen Upcoming Scoreboard" setting so it keeps the look it has always had until you change it. The center-gap settings size the scroll and Vegas card only.

upcoming_center.title: Middle of an Upcoming Card
upcoming_center.description: What to show between the two logos before a game starts. Upcoming games never show a score, since the game has not been played.

switch_upcoming_center.title: Middle of a Full-Screen Upcoming Scoreboard
switch_upcoming_center.description: What to show between the two logos on the full-screen (switch mode) scoreboard before a game starts. Defaults to the stacked date and time, which is what this display has always shown. Pick the matchup separator to use the same VS / @ / at text as the scroll and Vegas cards, or "Same as scroll and Vegas" to follow the setting above.

vs_text.title: Matchup Separator
vs_text.description: Text drawn between the two teams, e.g. VS, @, at, v. The away team is always on the left and the home team on the right, so "at" and "@" read correctly as "away at home". Leave blank to draw nothing.

date_format.title: Date Format
date_format.description: How to write the date: abbrev "Sep 19", numeric "9/19", day_first "19 Sep", numeric_day_first "19/9", weekday "Fri Sep 19".

switch_date_format.title: Full-Screen Date Format
switch_date_format.description: How the date is written on the full-screen (switch mode) scoreboard. Defaults to "9/19", which is what this display has always drawn, so it does not change until you pick something else. Choose "Same as scroll and Vegas" to follow the Date Format setting above instead.

show_date.title: Show Date
show_date.description: Draw the date on upcoming cards.

show_time.title: Show Time
show_time.description: Draw the start time on upcoming cards.

recent_show_date.title: Show Date (Recent Cards)
recent_show_date.description: Draw the date a finished game was played on the scroll and Vegas cards. Off by default because these cards have never drawn one and there is no spare row on a short panel - see Recent Date Position for where it goes. Written in the Date Format chosen above.

recent_date_position.title: Recent Date Position
recent_date_position.description: Where the recent card's date goes. "Own row" puts it in the clear strip between the FINAL line and the score, which needs a tall enough panel. "Top line" spends the FINAL line on the date instead - no loss on a card that is already showing a final score, and the only option that fits a 32px panel. "Auto" uses its own row where one fits and the top line where it does not.

labels.top_line: Top line, in place of FINAL

switch_show_date.title: Show Date (Full-Screen)
switch_show_date.description: Draw the date on the full-screen (switch mode) upcoming scoreboard. Show Date above now applies only to the scroll and Vegas cards. Before this release it also hid the full-screen date, so a config that turned it off shows the date here again until this switch is turned off.

switch_show_time.title: Show Time (Full-Screen)
switch_show_time.description: Draw the start time on the full-screen (switch mode) upcoming scoreboard. Show Time above now applies only to the scroll and Vegas cards. Before this release it also hid the full-screen time, so a config that turned it off shows the time here again until this switch is turned off.

switch_recent_show_date.title: Show Date (Full-Screen Recent)
switch_recent_show_date.description: Draw the date along the bottom of the full-screen (switch mode) recent scoreboard. That screen has always drawn it and there was no way to turn it off, so this defaults on and nothing changes until you clear it. It is now written in the Full-Screen Date Format below, which it used to ignore - a panel set to "Sep 19" showed "9/19" here.

swap_date_time.title: Swap Date and Time
swap_date_time.description: Put the date on top and the time along the bottom instead of the default.

center_gap.title: Center Gap
center_gap.description: Pixels kept clear down the middle so the score or VS is not drawn over the team logos. Leave unset to scale with the card width. 0 restores the old edge-to-edge logos.

center_gap_ratio.title: Center Gap Ratio
center_gap_ratio.description: Fraction of card width used for the centre gap when it is not pinned.

center_gap_min.title: Center Gap Minimum
center_gap_min.description: Lower bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

center_gap_max.title: Center Gap Maximum
center_gap_max.description: Upper bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the baseball scoreboard plugin

display_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the display controller to show this plugin mode before rotating to next plugin

update_interval.description: How often to fetch new data in seconds

game_display_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each individual game before rotating to the next game within the same mode

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to display event start times (e.g. America/Chicago). Leave blank to follow the LEDMatrix global timezone, or the system timezone if none is set. A bare "UTC" here is treated as a leftover from the old write-back bug and ignored when your global or system timezone disagrees — use "Etc/UTC" if you really want UTC.

exclude_teams.description: Team abbreviations to always hide from the live rotation and recent/final scores (e.g., to avoid spoilers if you're watching a game delayed). Takes priority over favorite_teams and every other filtering setting.

display_modes.title: Display Modes
display_modes.description: Control which game types to show

live_display_mode.description: Display mode for live games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

recent_display_mode.description: Display mode for recent games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

upcoming_display_mode.description: Display mode for upcoming games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

scroll_settings.title: Scroll Settings
scroll_settings.description: Settings for scroll display mode (when display mode is set to 'scroll')

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second (default: 50). Higher values scroll faster.

scroll_delay.description: Kept so saved configs still load; ignored. Scrolling is paced to the panel's refresh rate, and scroll_speed sets how fast it moves. HIDDEN: nothing reads it; scroll_speed is the only pacing control.

gap_between_games.description: Gap in pixels between game cards when scrolling

show_league_separators.description: Show league icons (MLB shield, NCAA logos) between different leagues

dynamic_duration.description: Automatically calculate display duration based on content width

game_card_width.description: Width of each game card in scroll mode (pixels). Default 128, which suits a single 128px panel. On a wider chain raise it so each card stays readable - roughly display width divided by 3 shows about three games at once. Lower it to fit more games on screen at the cost of detail.

live_priority.description: Give live games priority over other modes. When enabled, live games will interrupt the normal mode rotation and be displayed immediately when available.

live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each live game before rotating to the next. When a separate non-favorite duration is set, this applies to games with a favorite team; it applies to ALL live games when no favorite teams are configured.

non_favorite_live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds for live games that do NOT involve a favorite team. Only applies when favorite teams are set AND non-favorite live games are shown ('show_favorite_teams_only' off, or 'show_all_live' on). 0 (default) = use live_game_duration for every live game (no change).

recent_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each recent game before rotating to the next game. If not set, uses the top-level game_display_duration setting (default: 15 seconds).

upcoming_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each upcoming game before rotating to the next game. If not set, uses the top-level game_display_duration setting (default: 15 seconds).

live_update_interval.description: How often to update live game data (seconds)

recent_update_interval.description: How often the finished-games list is rebuilt (seconds). This also sets how often a game that has just ended can appear. Lower it if you want results sooner; each rebuild is one request against a shared cache.

upcoming_update_interval.description: How often the upcoming-games list is rebuilt (seconds). Selection and the non-favorite rotation both run on the display side now, so this only governs how often NEW games enter the pool -- an hour is usually right for a schedule that changes daily.

stale_game_timeout.description: How long a live game may go without an update before it is dropped from the rotation (seconds). Guards against a game the API stops reporting sitting on the board forever.

odds_update_interval.description: How often betting odds are refreshed for recent and upcoming games (seconds). Only matters when Show Odds is on.

live_odds_update_interval.description: How often betting odds are refreshed for games in progress (seconds). Only matters when Show Odds is on.

play_by_play_update_interval.description: How often the live game summary (pitcher, batter, last play) is refetched for the game on screen (seconds). Only matters when Show Pitcher/Batter, Show Last Play or Show Player Card is on.

player_bio_update_interval.description: How often a player's bio and headshot are refetched for the player card (seconds). Only matters when Show Player Card is on.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often to fetch new data for this league (seconds)

game_limits.title: Game Limits
game_limits.description: Control how many games to show

recent_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

upcoming_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

other_upcoming_games_to_show.title: Other upcoming games to show
other_upcoming_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite upcoming games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Your favorites are shown first, then this many other games. Set to 0 to show only your favorites. Ignored when 'Show favorite teams only' is on, or when no favorite teams are set.

other_recent_games_to_show.title: Other recent games to show
other_recent_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite recent games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Set to 0 to show only your favorites.

other_rotation_interval_seconds.title: Rotate other games every (seconds)
other_rotation_interval_seconds.description: How often (seconds) to advance the window of NON-favorite games, so the board works through the schedule over time instead of showing the same handful. Variety comes from this turnover rather than from a larger selection: a bigger selection makes a full cycle longer, which makes any given game appear less often. Set to 0 to keep a fixed selection. Only applies when favorite teams are set and 'Show favorite teams only' is off.

favorite_rotation_boost.title: Favorite game turns
favorite_rotation_boost.description: In switch mode, how many turns each favorite team's recent or upcoming game gets for every 1 turn other games get. The extra turns are spread through the rotation, and kept apart whenever there are enough other games to separate them. Set to 1 to show every game once per rotation.

other_games_min_quality.title: Which other games to show
other_games_min_quality.description: Which NON-favorite games are worth a slot. 'ranked' shows only games involving a nationally ranked team; 'any' is the old behaviour of whatever comes next chronologically. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this. A league with no national poll has nothing to rank against, so 'ranked' lets everything through there rather than emptying the slots. HIDDEN for this league: no national poll exists for it (_league_has_rankings matches college/ncaa leagues only), so "ranked" lets every game through and the setting has one meaningful value. Still live under NCAA Baseball.

other_games_divisions.title: Divisions to include (other games)
other_games_divisions.description: Which divisions the NON-favorite games may come from. At least one team has to be in a checked division, so with only FBS checked you still see a ranked FBS team hosting an FCS school, but two FCS teams playing each other are left out. Check FCS or Other to bring those in as well. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this, so a team from any division still always appears. FBS/FCS is a college FOOTBALL taxonomy and ESPN publishes those rosters for that league alone, so this setting does nothing in any other league -- no lookup is even attempted. HIDDEN: inert in this plugin. ESPN publishes division rosters for college-football alone (sports.py _DIVISION_GROUPS_BY_LEAGUE), so for MLB, MiLB and NCAA Baseball the lookup returns nothing, the filter fails open, and no choice here can change what is shown. Kept declared so saved configs keep validating.

show_ranking.description: Show team rankings (when available) HIDDEN for this league: it has no poll, so the rank table is always empty -- and because a rank badge replaces the record outright, turning this on erased the records that Show Records was drawing. Still live under NCAA Baseball.

show_innings.description: Show the inning (arrow and number) at the top of the live scorebug, and the batting-half arrow on the traditional scoreboard. A finished game's FINAL is always shown.

show_bases.description: Show the base-runner diamonds on the live scorebug

show_outs.description: Show the outs indicator on the live scorebug and the O row of the traditional scoreboard's At Bat panel.

show_count.description: Show the balls-strikes count on the live scorebug and the B and S rows of the traditional scoreboard's At Bat panel.

show_pitcher_batter.title: Show Now Batting / Now Pitching
show_pitcher_batter.description: Periodically show a Now Batting / Now Pitching card for whoever is at the plate and on the mound during a live game. Timing and style are under Customization > Pitcher / Batter Player Card. Needs an extra ESPN play-by-play fetch per live game, plus a one-off athlete lookup per player for the card

show_last_play.description: Show a short code for the most recently completed play (1B, HR, K, BB, etc.) on the pitcher/batter screen

show_game_activity.title: Show Game Activity
show_game_activity.description: Draw a running pitch-by-pitch commentary line for live games - fouls, strikes, the count, and ESPN's sentence for a hit or a steal. Off by default: it is the busiest thing on the board, and it is meant for the games where nothing else is happening. See the Game Activity section for where it goes and how much it says.

show_player_card.description: Periodically show a full player card for the current batter (and optionally pitcher): headshot, jersey number, position, bat/throw, and season stats (AVG/HR/RBI for hitters, ERA/W-L/K for pitchers). Requires an extra ESPN athlete lookup; not available for MiLB. Configure look/timing under Customization > Player Card

show_traditional_scoreboard.description: Periodically show a full-screen traditional ballpark scoreboard: inning-by-inning line score, R/H/E, and an At Bat panel with ball/strike/out indicators

game_activity.title: Game Activity
game_activity.description: The pitch-by-pitch commentary line: fouls, called and swinging strikes, the count, and ESPN's own sentence for a hit or a steal ("Burleson homered to right center (395 feet)."). Built for a 1-0 pitchers' duel, where the score alone gives the board nothing to say. Needs the ESPN game summary, so it is offered for MLB and NCAA Baseball only - MiLB comes from the MLB Stats API and has no summary endpoint.

position.title: Where it goes
position.description: "Inline" draws it along the bottom of the live scoreboard, which needs a clear band below the bases and count - a wide panel has one, a short one does not. "Screen" gives it its own card in the rotation instead. "Auto" measures the fonts and panel actually in use and picks; an explicit "inline" that cannot fit draws nothing rather than printing over the count.

detail.title: How much to say
detail.description: Terse is the bare event ("Foul"). Normal adds the batter and the count ("J. Walker Foul 0-1"). Rich adds the pitch on a second line ("97 mph Four-seam FB") - the most alive, and the most demanding of panel height.

dwell_seconds.title: Seconds per play
dwell_seconds.description: How long each play stays up. A poll returns several plays at once - a pitch takes about 25s and the data refreshes roughly every 30s - so these are walked through locally rather than all but the newest being thrown away. Too long and the board falls behind the game.

include.title: What to announce
include.description: Mute a class of play to quieten the line without turning it off.

pitches.title: Pitches
pitches.description: Balls, fouls, called and swinging strikes - the heartbeat, and the bulk of the feed.

outcomes.title: At-bat outcomes
outcomes.description: Hits, outs and strikeouts, in ESPN's own words.

baserunning.title: Baserunning
baserunning.description: Steals, pickoffs, wild pitches and balks.

show_favorite_teams_only.description: Only show games from favorite teams

show_all_live.description: Show all live games, not just favorites

favorite_live_boost.description: How many turns your favorite team's live game gets in the rotation for every 1 turn other live games get. Your favorite's game is also always queued first whenever the live rotation refreshes. Set to 1 for even rotation.

mode_durations.title: Mode Duration Overrides
mode_durations.description: Override how long each mode displays before rotating

recent_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for recent games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

upcoming_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for upcoming games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

live_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for live games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

dynamic_duration.title: MLB Dynamic Duration Settings
dynamic_duration.description: Configure dynamic duration settings for MLB games.

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for MLB games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum total duration in seconds for this mode, even if few games are available. Ensures the mode stays visible long enough.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum total duration in seconds for this mode, even if many games are available.

modes.title: Per-Mode Settings for MLB
modes.description: Configure dynamic duration for specific MLB modes

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for MLB live games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for MLB live mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for MLB live games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for MLB recent games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for MLB recent mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for MLB recent games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for MLB upcoming games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for MLB upcoming mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for MLB upcoming games

milb.title: MiLB Settings
milb.description: Configuration for MiLB (Minor League Baseball) games

favorite_teams.description: List of favorite MiLB team abbreviations (e.g., DUR, SWB). Use 2-4 letter codes.

sport_ids.title: MiLB Levels
sport_ids.description: Which levels of the minors to fetch. MiLB comes from the MLB Stats API, which identifies each level by a number; leave all four checked for every affiliate, or narrow it to the level your club plays at so the board is not filled with games you do not follow. Clearing every box falls back to all four rather than showing nothing.

live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each live game before rotating to the next. When a separate non-favorite duration is set, this applies to games with a favorite team; it applies to ALL live games when no favorite teams are configured.

non_favorite_live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds for live games that do NOT involve a favorite team. Only applies when favorite teams are set AND non-favorite live games are shown ('show_favorite_teams_only' off, or 'show_all_live' on). 0 (default) = use live_game_duration for every live game (no change).

recent_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each recent game before rotating to the next game. If not set, uses the top-level game_display_duration setting (default: 15 seconds).

upcoming_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each upcoming game before rotating to the next game. If not set, uses the top-level game_display_duration setting (default: 15 seconds).

live_update_interval.description: How often to update live game data (seconds)

recent_update_interval.description: How often the finished-games list is rebuilt (seconds). This also sets how often a game that has just ended can appear. Lower it if you want results sooner; each rebuild is one request against a shared cache.

upcoming_update_interval.description: How often the upcoming-games list is rebuilt (seconds). Selection and the non-favorite rotation both run on the display side now, so this only governs how often NEW games enter the pool -- an hour is usually right for a schedule that changes daily.

stale_game_timeout.description: How long a live game may go without an update before it is dropped from the rotation (seconds). Guards against a game the API stops reporting sitting on the board forever.

odds_update_interval.description: How often betting odds are refreshed for recent and upcoming games (seconds). Only matters when Show Odds is on.

live_odds_update_interval.description: How often betting odds are refreshed for games in progress (seconds). Only matters when Show Odds is on.

play_by_play_update_interval.description: How often the live game summary (pitcher, batter, last play) is refetched for the game on screen (seconds). Only matters when Show Pitcher/Batter, Show Last Play or Show Player Card is on.

player_bio_update_interval.description: How often a player's bio and headshot are refetched for the player card (seconds). Only matters when Show Player Card is on.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often to fetch new data for this league (seconds)

game_limits.title: Game Limits
game_limits.description: Control how many games to show

recent_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

upcoming_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

other_upcoming_games_to_show.title: Other upcoming games to show
other_upcoming_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite upcoming games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Your favorites are shown first, then this many other games. Set to 0 to show only your favorites. Ignored when 'Show favorite teams only' is on, or when no favorite teams are set.

other_recent_games_to_show.title: Other recent games to show
other_recent_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite recent games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Set to 0 to show only your favorites.

other_rotation_interval_seconds.title: Rotate other games every (seconds)
other_rotation_interval_seconds.description: How often (seconds) to advance the window of NON-favorite games, so the board works through the schedule over time instead of showing the same handful. Variety comes from this turnover rather than from a larger selection: a bigger selection makes a full cycle longer, which makes any given game appear less often. Set to 0 to keep a fixed selection. Only applies when favorite teams are set and 'Show favorite teams only' is off.

favorite_rotation_boost.title: Favorite game turns
favorite_rotation_boost.description: In switch mode, how many turns each favorite team's recent or upcoming game gets for every 1 turn other games get. The extra turns are spread through the rotation, and kept apart whenever there are enough other games to separate them. Set to 1 to show every game once per rotation.

other_games_min_quality.title: Which other games to show
other_games_min_quality.description: Which NON-favorite games are worth a slot. 'ranked' shows only games involving a nationally ranked team; 'any' is the old behaviour of whatever comes next chronologically. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this. A league with no national poll has nothing to rank against, so 'ranked' lets everything through there rather than emptying the slots. HIDDEN for this league too: measured 2026-09-24, baseball/college-baseball/rankings answers 404 while /scoreboard and /standings on the same slug answer 200 -- the endpoint does not exist, so there is no poll here either. This was left visible in the first pass on the assumption that a college league must have one. Its default moves from "ranked" to "any", which is what every board was already showing -- "ranked" with no poll lets every game through -- and stops the hourly standings request the old default triggered.

other_games_divisions.title: Divisions to include (other games)
other_games_divisions.description: Which divisions the NON-favorite games may come from. At least one team has to be in a checked division, so with only FBS checked you still see a ranked FBS team hosting an FCS school, but two FCS teams playing each other are left out. Check FCS or Other to bring those in as well. Your favorite teams are never filtered by this, so a team from any division still always appears. FBS/FCS is a college FOOTBALL taxonomy and ESPN publishes those rosters for that league alone, so this setting does nothing in any other league -- no lookup is even attempted. HIDDEN: inert in this plugin. ESPN publishes division rosters for college-football alone (sports.py _DIVISION_GROUPS_BY_LEAGUE), so for MLB, MiLB and NCAA Baseball the lookup returns nothing, the filter fails open, and no choice here can change what is shown. Kept declared so saved configs keep validating.

show_ranking.description: Show team rankings (rankings can be important in college baseball) HIDDEN for this league too: measured 2026-09-24, baseball/college-baseball/rankings answers 404 while /scoreboard and /standings on the same slug answer 200 -- the endpoint does not exist, so there is no poll here either. This was left visible in the first pass on the assumption that a college league must have one. As on MLB and MiLB, the badge replaces the record, so turning it on erased the records Show Records was drawing.

show_innings.description: Show the inning (arrow and number) at the top of the live scorebug, and the batting-half arrow on the traditional scoreboard. A finished game's FINAL is always shown.

show_bases.description: Show the base-runner diamonds on the live scorebug

show_outs.description: Show the outs indicator on the live scorebug and the O row of the traditional scoreboard's At Bat panel. NCAA Baseball's feed has no outs or count, so this has nothing to hide there.

show_count.description: Show the balls-strikes count on the live scorebug and the B and S rows of the traditional scoreboard's At Bat panel. NCAA Baseball's feed has no outs or count, so this has nothing to hide there.

show_pitcher_batter.title: Show Now Batting / Now Pitching
show_pitcher_batter.description: Periodically show a Now Batting / Now Pitching card for whoever is at the plate and on the mound during a live game. Timing and style are under Customization > Pitcher / Batter Player Card. Needs an extra ESPN play-by-play fetch per live game, plus a one-off athlete lookup per player for the card

show_last_play.description: Show a short code for the most recently completed play (1B, HR, K, BB, etc.) on the pitcher/batter screen

show_game_activity.title: Show Game Activity
show_game_activity.description: Draw a running pitch-by-pitch commentary line for live games - fouls, strikes, the count, and ESPN's sentence for a hit or a steal. Off by default: it is the busiest thing on the board, and it is meant for the games where nothing else is happening. See the Game Activity section for where it goes and how much it says.

show_player_card.description: Periodically show a full player card for the current batter (and optionally pitcher): headshot, jersey number, position, bat/throw, and season stats (AVG/HR/RBI for hitters, ERA/W-L/K for pitchers). Requires an extra ESPN athlete lookup; not available for MiLB. Configure look/timing under Customization > Player Card

show_traditional_scoreboard.description: Periodically show a full-screen traditional ballpark scoreboard: inning-by-inning line score, R/H/E, and an At Bat panel with ball/strike/out indicators

game_activity.title: Game Activity
game_activity.description: The pitch-by-pitch commentary line: fouls, called and swinging strikes, the count, and ESPN's own sentence for a hit or a steal ("Burleson homered to right center (395 feet)."). Built for a 1-0 pitchers' duel, where the score alone gives the board nothing to say. Needs the ESPN game summary, so it is offered for MLB and NCAA Baseball only - MiLB comes from the MLB Stats API and has no summary endpoint.

position.title: Where it goes
position.description: "Inline" draws it along the bottom of the live scoreboard, which needs a clear band below the bases and count - a wide panel has one, a short one does not. "Screen" gives it its own card in the rotation instead. "Auto" measures the fonts and panel actually in use and picks; an explicit "inline" that cannot fit draws nothing rather than printing over the count.

detail.title: How much to say
detail.description: Terse is the bare event ("Foul"). Normal adds the batter and the count ("J. Walker Foul 0-1"). Rich adds the pitch on a second line ("97 mph Four-seam FB") - the most alive, and the most demanding of panel height.

dwell_seconds.title: Seconds per play
dwell_seconds.description: How long each play stays up. A poll returns several plays at once - a pitch takes about 25s and the data refreshes roughly every 30s - so these are walked through locally rather than all but the newest being thrown away. Too long and the board falls behind the game.

include.title: What to announce
include.description: Mute a class of play to quieten the line without turning it off.

pitches.title: Pitches
pitches.description: Balls, fouls, called and swinging strikes - the heartbeat, and the bulk of the feed.

outcomes.title: At-bat outcomes
outcomes.description: Hits, outs and strikeouts, in ESPN's own words.

baserunning.title: Baserunning
baserunning.description: Steals, pickoffs, wild pitches and balks.

show_favorite_teams_only.description: Only show games from favorite teams

show_all_live.description: Show all live games, not just favorites

favorite_live_boost.description: How many turns your favorite team's live game gets in the rotation for every 1 turn other live games get. Your favorite's game is also always queued first whenever the live rotation refreshes. Set to 1 for even rotation.

mode_durations.title: Mode Duration Overrides
mode_durations.description: Override how long each mode displays before rotating

recent_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for recent games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

upcoming_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for upcoming games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

live_mode_duration.description: Override display duration for live games mode (seconds). Null uses default.

dynamic_duration.title: NCAA Baseball Dynamic Duration Settings
dynamic_duration.description: Configure dynamic duration settings for NCAA Baseball games.

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NCAA Baseball games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum total duration in seconds for this mode, even if few games are available. Ensures the mode stays visible long enough.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum total duration in seconds for this mode, even if many games are available.

modes.title: Per-Mode Settings for NCAA Baseball
modes.description: Configure dynamic duration for specific NCAA Baseball modes

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NCAA Baseball live games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for NCAA Baseball live mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for NCAA Baseball live games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NCAA Baseball recent games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for NCAA Baseball recent mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for NCAA Baseball recent games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NCAA Baseball upcoming games

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum duration for NCAA Baseball upcoming mode

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for NCAA Baseball upcoming games

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts, colors, and layout positioning for scoreboard elements

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the score text on scroll/Vegas cards.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the status text on scroll/Vegas cards.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the detail text on scroll/Vegas cards.

odds_text.title: Odds Text
odds_text.description: Customize the betting line and over/under text.

font.description: Font family for odds text. Defaults to the same 4x6 font the detail text uses; press_start is chunkier and easier to read on a large panel, but roughly twice as wide.

font_size.description: Font size for odds text. Sizes snap to the font's pixel grid to stay crisp: 4x6-font.ttf snaps to 7, 14, 21; press_start to 8, 16.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the odds text.

layout.title: Layout Positioning
layout.description: Adjust X,Y coordinate offsets for elements. Values are relative to default positions. Use negative values to move left/up, positive to move right/down.

date.title: Game Date
date.description: Moves the date along the bottom of the recent scoreboard and the date on an upcoming card.

status.title: Game Status/Inning
status.description: Moves "Next Game" on the upcoming scoreboard and "Final" on the recent one. Also accepted as status_text in a hand-edited config.

record.title: Team Records

away_x_offset.description: Additional horizontal offset for away team record (default: 0)

home_x_offset.description: Additional horizontal offset for home team record (default: 0)

record.description: Moves the win-loss record (or rank badge) in the bottom corners on the recent and upcoming scoreboards. Also accepted as records in a hand-edited config. These are the only offsets the rank badge has: it is drawn in the record slot, so layout.ranking has no effect.

ranking.title: Team Rankings
ranking.description: HIDDEN: no reader. The rank badge shares the records row and is positioned by the Record offsets above.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the period text on scroll/Vegas cards.

font.description: Font family for team name text

font_size.description: Font size for team name text

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the team name on scroll/Vegas cards.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the rank text on scroll/Vegas cards.

diamond_size.description: Size of each base diamond in pixels

occupied_color.description: Color when a base is occupied (RGB)

empty_color.description: Outline color when a base is empty (RGB)

x_offset.description: Horizontal offset for the bases cluster (positive = right)

y_offset.description: Vertical offset for the bases cluster (positive = down)

circle_diameter.description: Diameter of each out circle in pixels

spacing.description: Vertical spacing between out circles in pixels

distance_from_bases.description: Horizontal distance from the bases cluster in pixels

at_bat_info.title: Pitcher / Batter Player Card
at_bat_info.description: A dedicated full-screen view (not an overlay on the scorebug -- there is not enough room there) that periodically rotates into the live display for whoever is at the plate and on the mound. By default it is drawn as a baseball card: headshot, a NOW BATTING / NOW PITCHING banner, the player's name, season stats, team and number, age and bat/throw hand, hometown, and height/weight -- with the panel keeping as many of those rows as it has room for. Set style to 'text' for the original plain pitcher/batter line-up. On by default for MLB and NCAA Baseball; turn it off per league with Display Options > Show Now Batting / Now Pitching (not available for MiLB, which has no ESPN play-by-play).

style.title: Style
style.description: How this screen is drawn. 'card' is a full baseball card for one player at a time -- headshot, banner, name, season stats, team/number/position, age and bat/throw, hometown, height/weight -- dropping the least important rows on panels too small to fit them all. 'text' is the original layout: a 'Pitcher: X' line, a 'Batter: Y' line and the last-play code. Card style needs the extra ESPN athlete lookup and is unavailable for MiLB; when no bio has resolved yet it falls back to the text layout on its own rather than drawing an empty card.

show_batter.title: Show Batter Card
show_batter.description: Card style only. Include a card for the current batter

show_pitcher.title: Show Pitcher Card
show_pitcher.description: Card style only. Include a card for the current pitcher. With both on, each card gets its own dwell_seconds -- batter first -- so one rotation shows both cards instead of making the pitcher wait for the screen to come round again.

show_headshot.description: Card style only. Draw the player's ESPN headshot on the left of the card, framed in their team's colour. Hidden automatically on panels narrower than 96 pixels or shorter than 32, and whenever the image has not been cached yet -- the card then uses the full width for text

show_stats.description: Card style only. Include the season stat line (AVG/HR/RBI for a hitter, ERA/K/WHIP for a pitcher -- ESPN picks the set that suits the position). Trailing stats are dropped whole on a narrow panel rather than cut part-way through a number

show_bio_details.description: Card style only. Include the trivia rows -- age and bat/throw hand, hometown, height/weight and seasons played. These are the first rows a short panel drops anyway; turn this off to keep a tall panel to the name, stats and team

header_bar.description: Card style only. Draw the NOW BATTING / NOW PITCHING banner as black text knocked out of a solid team-colour bar instead of plain coloured text. Only applies on panels 48 pixels tall or more, where the banner row is tall enough for it to read

font.description: Font for this screen's text -- a clean, bold bitmap font that auto-fits as large as the display and each line's actual text allows (falling back to a smaller same-family font, e.g. on a narrow display or with a long player name, down to as small as '4x6-font.ttf' -- ('four_by_six') was previously the flat default here, but it renders 'B' and '8' almost identically, making last-play codes like 'BB' misreadable as '88'; the fallback ladder never steps down to it for this reason). A fixed-size .bdf font always renders at its own native pixel size regardless of font_size below; use a scalable .ttf font (e.g. 'press_start') if you want font_size to directly control the size.

font_size.description: Maximum font size cap, for scalable .ttf fonts only (ignored by fixed-size .bdf fonts like the default). This screen auto-fits the largest text that still fits every line, so the default effectively means 'as big as the display and text allow' -- lower it to force a smaller, more consistent size.

use_team_colors.description: Colour the card's banner, name and headshot frame (and, in text style, the pitcher and batter lines) with the real ESPN team colour -- the fielding team for the pitcher, the batting team for the hitter -- instead of the flat pitcher_color/batter_color below. Falls back to those flat colours when off, or when a team's colour isn't available.

pitcher_color.description: Text colour [R, G, B] for the pitcher's banner and name when use_team_colors is off or the fielding team's colour is unavailable

batter_color.description: Text colour [R, G, B] for the batter's banner and name when use_team_colors is off or the batting team's colour is unavailable

last_play_color.description: Text colour [R, G, B] for the last-play code line in text style. The card shows the code in the banner instead, in the banner's own colour

text_color.description: Card style only. Text colour [R, G, B] for the team / number / position row

stat_color.description: Card style only. Text colour [R, G, B] for the season stat line

detail_color.description: Card style only. Text colour [R, G, B] for the quieter trivia rows -- age and bat/throw, hometown, height/weight

dwell_seconds.title: Seconds Per Card
dwell_seconds.description: How many seconds each Now Batting / Now Pitching card stays on screen. In card style with both players on, each card gets this long -- batter first, then pitcher -- so the screen stays up for twice this time. In text style, how long the screen stays each time it rotates in

interval_seconds.title: Show Every (Seconds)
interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds, counted from when the cards last appeared) the Now Batting / Now Pitching cards rotate into the live view. The default of 30 matches the default live_game_duration, so each live game gets one pass of the cards -- 8 seconds for both cards, then 22 seconds of scoreboard

favorites_only.title: Favorite Teams Only
favorites_only.description: Only rotate this screen in for games involving one of this league's favorite_teams. Useful if show_all_live is on (so every team's live game rotates through) but you only want the pitcher/batter/last-play treatment for your own team -- other teams still get the normal compact scorebug. Has no effect if favorite_teams is empty.

player_card.title: Player Card Screen
player_card.description: A dedicated full-screen player card that periodically rotates into the live display for the current batter (and optionally pitcher): headshot image, jersey number, position, bat/throw hand, and season stats (AVG/HR/RBI for hitters, ERA/W-L/K for pitchers). Enable per-league via Display Options > Show Player Card (MLB and NCAA Baseball only -- MiLB has no ESPN player data). On tiny panels (e.g. 64x32) the headshot is hidden and the card shows compact text.

font.description: Font for the card's text -- a clean, bold bitmap font that auto-fits the largest size the panel and text allow. A fixed-size .bdf font renders at its native pixel size regardless of font_size; use a scalable .ttf font (e.g. 'press_start') if you want font_size to control the size.

font_size.description: Maximum font size cap, for scalable .ttf fonts only (ignored by fixed-size .bdf fonts like the default). The card auto-fits within the space beside the headshot, so the default effectively means 'as big as fits' -- lower it to force a smaller size.

show_batter.description: Show a card for the current batter

show_pitcher.description: Also show a card for the current pitcher (the batter is preferred when both are available)

use_team_colors.description: Color the player's name with their real ESPN team color instead of the flat text_color

use_team_colors_border.description: Draw the headshot's frame in the player's team color instead of the flat border_color below

border_color.description: Headshot frame color [R, G, B] when use_team_colors_border is off or the team color is unavailable

text_color.description: Text color [R, G, B] for the name (when team colors are off) and the jersey/position/bat-throw line

stat_color.description: Text color [R, G, B] for the season-stats line

dwell_seconds.description: How many seconds to show the card each time it rotates in

interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) the card rotates into the normal live view

favorites_only.description: Only rotate the card in for games involving one of this league's favorite_teams. Has no effect if favorite_teams is empty.

traditional_scoreboard.title: Traditional Scoreboard Screen
traditional_scoreboard.description: A dedicated full-screen view (like an outfield ballpark scoreboard) that periodically rotates into the live display: an inning-by-inning line score with R/H/E, and an At Bat panel with ball/strike/out indicators. Enable per-league via Display Options > Show Traditional Scoreboard (MLB and NCAA Baseball only).

font.description: Font for this screen's text. '9x15.bdf' is a clean, bold, highly legible bitmap font. Fixed-size bitmap (.bdf) fonts always render at their own native pixel size regardless of font_size below; use a scalable .ttf font (e.g. 'press_start' for PressStart2P, a chunkier 8-bit retro look) if you want font_size to control the size

font_size.description: Maximum font size cap, for scalable .ttf fonts only (ignored by fixed-size .bdf fonts like the default). This screen auto-fits the largest text that still leaves room for the At Bat panel (when applicable), so the default (24) effectively means 'as big as the display allows' -- lower this to force a smaller, more consistent size instead

use_team_colors.description: Color each team's abbreviation using their real team colors (from ESPN) instead of a single flat text color

show_team_color_backgrounds.description: Tint each team's row with a subtle (~12% brightness) wash of their real ESPN team color, plus a solid team-color accent strip on the left edge -- a colorful ballpark look. Requires use_team_colors; a team with no ESPN color gets no tint. Text stays legible (it is drawn with a black outline over the wash).

show_logos.description: Show a small team logo beside each abbreviation, but only when there's leftover width to spare -- never at the cost of a displayed inning or the At Bat side panel

text_color.description: Text color [R, G, B] for score digits, and for team abbreviations when team colors are off or unavailable

header_color.description: Text color [R, G, B] for the inning-number and R/H/E header row

highlight_color.description: Accent color [R, G, B] for the current-inning highlight, the At Bat label, and lit ball/strike/out indicators

show_dividers.description: Draw thin 1px grid lines between innings, rows, and the R/H/E columns for readability

game_scope.description: Which games this screen rotates in for: 'live' only during live action, 'recent' only for final/completed games (handy for seeing the winner and full line score at a glance), or 'both'

favorites_only.description: Only rotate this screen in for games involving one of this league's favorite_teams. Useful if show_all_live is on (so every team's live game rotates through) but you only want the full-screen treatment for your own team -- other teams still get the normal compact scorebug. Has no effect if favorite_teams is empty.

divider_color.description: Color [R, G, B] for the grid divider lines

highlight_winner.description: On a final game, color the winning team's run total in winner_color so the winner is obvious at a glance instead of having to compare both R values yourself

winner_color.description: Color [R, G, B] for the winning team's run total on a final game

dwell_seconds.description: How many seconds to show this screen each time it rotates in

interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) this screen rotates into the normal live view

favorite_result_colors.title: Favorite Team Result Colors
favorite_result_colors.description: Color the final score of a recent game by how your favorite team did. Most useful in scroll and Vegas modes, where the same matchup can go past several times and the logos alone do not tell you who won.

enabled.title: Color Scores by Result
enabled.description: Show the final score in green when your favorite team won and red when it lost. Games without exactly one favorite team - neither side, or both - keep the normal score color.

win_color.title: Win Color
win_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when your favorite team won

loss_color.title: Loss Color
loss_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when your favorite team lost

tie_color.title: Tie Color
tie_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when the game ended level

schedule_lookback_days.title: Schedule lookback (days)
schedule_lookback_days.description: How far back to fetch games for the Recent screen. Raise it if finished games disappear sooner than you want.

schedule_lookahead_days.title: Schedule lookahead (days)
schedule_lookahead_days.description: How far ahead to fetch games for the Upcoming screen. Raise it for a league that plays weekly: a fixture just beyond this horizon is not fetched at all, so it never reaches the board even though the date is known.

no_data_interval_seconds.title: Idle live-check interval (seconds)
no_data_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait between checks for live games when there are none. Backs off further the longer nothing is found, up to the cap below.

live_idle_max_interval_seconds.title: Maximum idle live-check interval (seconds)
live_idle_max_interval_seconds.description: Ceiling for the back-off above. Raise it to poll an out-of-season league even less; lower it to notice the first game after a quiet spell sooner.
